VAR-welfare.why: Total household disposable income is the closest welfare aggregate candidate (EU-SILC-style income aggregate)

VAR-welfaredef.why: If a spatially deflated welfare aggregate is required, start from total household disposable income and apply regional deflators (region codes in silc24_h.hb031; deflators table noted as reference)

VAR-welfarenom.why: Nominal welfare aggregate candidate: total household disposable income (before any spatial/price adjustment)

VAR-welfareother.why: No separate alternative welfare aggregate column is apparent; check whether an alternative aggregate is constructed externally from the income components

VAR-welfareothertype.why: Type for any alternative welfare aggregate appears to be metadata (not directly collected); likely authored based on which aggregate is used

VAR-welfaretype.why: Welfare aggregate type (poverty) appears to be metadata (e.g., disposable income vs consumption); likely tied to hg110 if used as welfare

VAR-welfshprosperity.why: Shared prosperity welfare aggregate candidate: same underlying income aggregate (hg110) before any per-capita/equivalization step

VAR-welfshprtype.why: Shared prosperity welfare type appears to be metadata (not directly collected); likely authored based on the chosen aggregate (e.g., disposable income)

notes: No explicit household-size or equivalised/consumption welfare variables are listed in the index; welfare likely constructed from hg110 and household roster counts.
